scenarios.fact: Exact deterministic dataset and three personas exist in the fresh target or arm-isolated namespace.
Alice and Bob read the shared workspace.
Mallory cannot read or subscribe to the workspace.
A member creates, edits, completes, reopens, reorders, and deletes tasks.
A second connected client observes a committed change without refresh.
A previously opened client boots with retained tasks while backend transport is unavailable.
The offline client queues one create and one update.
Reconnect settles both queued writes exactly once.
Concurrent title edits produce the documented deterministic outcome.
Concurrent reorder preserves a valid unique stable ordering.
Logout stops delivery and handles protected retained data per the provider contract.
Membership removal stops Bob's future protected delivery.
Frozen small-profile read, write, realtime, reconnect, and build/deploy samples are retained.
Only the exact fresh targets or arm-owned shared-target namespace are cleaned up; unrelated baseline state is preserved.
